name: Landing page is usable at mobile viewport width
description: At a 390px-wide mobile viewport the landing renders without horizontal overflow and the mode switch plus primary CTA remain reachable.

planSteps.description: Set the browser viewport to a mobile size (390x844) and navigate to the app root URL /.
Verify the page renders with the hero content visible and no horizontal scrollbar/overflow (content fits the viewport width).
Scroll through the landing page from top to bottom.
Verify sections and the footer render without overlapping or cut-off text.
Tap the 'Template studio — HTML decks' mode switch tab.
Verify the Template studio view renders correctly at mobile width with the template gallery and brief area usable.
Tap back to the 'Studio — structured' tab.
Verify the Studio workbench renders at mobile width and the 'Forge the outline' button is visible and tappable.
